{"test_cases": [
    {
        "id": "TC1",
        "title": "Positive Test Case for Registration with Valid Data",
        "type": "positive",
        "preconditions": "User has a valid email address that is not registered, and a valid password and name.",
        "steps": [
            "User visits the registration page.",
            "User enters a valid name.",
            "User enters a valid email address that is not registered.",
            "User enters a valid password.",
            "User clicks the 'Register' button."
        ],
        "expected_result": "User is redirected to a confirmation page with a confirmation email sent to the user's email address.",
        "covers": ["AC1", "AC2", "AC3"]
    },
    {
        "id": "TC2",
        "title": "Negative Test Case for Registration with Invalid Email",
        "type": "negative",
        "preconditions": "User has a valid name and password.",
        "steps": [
            "User visits the registration page.",
            "User enters a valid name.",
            "User enters an invalid email address (e.g., 'invalidemail') that is not registered.",
            "User enters a valid password.",
            "User clicks the 'Register' button."
        ],
        "expected_result": "Page shows 'Email already registered' message.",
        "covers": ["AC1", "AC2"]
    },
    {
        "id": "TC3",
        "title": "Negative Test Case for Registration with Invalid Password",
        "type": "negative",
        "preconditions": "User has a valid name and email address that is not registered.",
        "steps": [
            "User visits the registration page.",
            "User enters a valid name.",
            "User enters a valid email address that is not registered.",
            "User enters an invalid password (e.g., 'shortpassword') that is too short.",
            "User clicks the 'Register' button."
        ],
        "expected_result": "Page shows 'Password must be at least 8 characters' message.",
        "covers": ["AC1"]
    },
    {
        "id": "TC4",
        "title": "Negative Test Case for Registration with Invalid Name",
        "type": "negative",
        "preconditions": "User has a valid email address that is not registered and a valid password.",
        "steps": [
            "User visits the registration page.",
            "User enters an invalid name (e.g., 'abc') that is too short.",
            "User enters a valid email address that is not registered.",
            "User enters a valid password.",
            "User clicks the 'Register' button."
        ],
        "expected_result": "Page shows 'Name must be at least 3 characters' message.",
        "covers": ["AC1"]
    },
    {
        "id": "TC5",
        "title": "Negative Test Case for Registration with Invalid Email (Not Registered)",
        "type": "negative",
        "preconditions": "User has a valid name and password.",
        "steps": [
            "User visits the registration page.",
            "User enters a valid name.",
            "User enters an invalid email address (e.g., 'invalidemail') that is already registered.",
            "User enters a valid password.",
            "User clicks the 'Register' button."
        ],
        "expected_result": "Page shows 'Email already registered' message.",
        "covers": ["AC1", "AC2"]
    },
    {
        "id": "TC6",
        "title": "Boundary Test Case for Registration with Minimum Age",
        "type": "boundary",
        "preconditions": "User has a valid name, email address that is not registered, and a valid password.",
        "steps": [
            "User visits the registration page.",
            "User enters a valid name.",
            "User enters a valid email address that is not registered.",
            "User enters a valid password.",
            "User selects a date of birth that is exactly 18 years old.",
            "User clicks the 'Register' button."
        ],
        "expected_result": "User is redirected to a confirmation page with a confirmation email sent to the user's email address.",
        "covers": ["AC1", "AC3"]
    },
    {
        "id": "TC7",
        "title": "Boundary Test Case for Registration with Maximum Age",
        "type": "boundary",
        "preconditions": "User has a valid name, email address that is not registered, and a valid password.",
        "steps": [
            "User visits the registration page.",
            "User enters a valid name.",
            "User enters a valid email address that is not registered.",
            "User enters a valid password.",
            "User selects a date of birth that is exactly 17 years old.",
            "User clicks the 'Register' button."
        ],
        "expected_result": "User is redirected to a confirmation page with a confirmation email sent to the user's email address.",
        "covers": ["AC1", "AC3"]
    }
]}
